about.heading: A little about me.
paragraphs: I’ve spent much of my time building interfaces and making software faster. I also keep finding reasons to go further down the stack: into models, the maths behind them, and sometimes the hardware they run on.
I like being able to take an idea apart, understand the pieces, and build something with them. That’s what connects most of the work here.

aboutPage.title: About — Mihir Karbelkar
aboutPage.heading: I’m Mihir.
background: I’ve worked with React and TypeScript, on frontend performance, and on backend platforms. At Ati Motors, I worked on scaling a robot fleet platform. In payments engineering, my work included high-traffic product surfaces and frontend bundle reductions.
My AI work includes research tools for public markets, retrieval workflows and experiments with model learning. I keep the project pages separate so I can describe the actual work and its limits.
